notes.title: Release Notes for 2024/02/29
notes.content:
[b]GAME[/b]
- Updated Mapbase to version 7.1
- Added basic Computers implementation
- Added HL2 Lost Coast content to fix missing assets
- Added extra custom addons used by maps (thanks to XBLAH & modding-assets.net, used with CC-BY-4.0 license)

[b]MAPS[/b]
Dev Prologue
- New map, experimental (and very short) intro sequence (dev_prologue)

City 3
- Expanded Bank and Store areas (dev_city_03_v2d)

Dev Combat Pistol
- Updated layout (dev_combat_pistol_v2a)
